assertions: Spawns 6 parallel specialist agents in Phase 3, including the Simplicity & Over-Engineering agent
Reports at least one OE- finding, each carrying exactly one tag from [delete]/[reuse]/[stdlib]/[builtin]/[unneeded]/[simplify]
Includes a line reading 'Estimated lines removable (static count, not a benchmark): ~N'
Does not state or imply a percentage, runtime, token, or bundle-size saving anywhere in the report

Retrieves the full PR diff and focuses findings on changed lines, using surrounding code only for context

The wrapper's unnecessary abstraction is still reported separately as its own OE- finding
